content: ONNX Runtime arena allocation is default for CPU. Arena params: initial_chunk_size_bytes controls first allocation, doubles each subsequent. GPU memory leaks confirmed with specific batch size sequences (e.g., [16,7,7,7] leaks, [16,6,6,6] does not). CUDA memory cache grows monotonically - after processing long sequences, peak memory never drops. Multiple GitHub issues confirm GPU memory not released after session drop. TensorRT optimization specifically triggers memory leaks that normal ONNX models don't have.
